capabilities.problem: Stage2 selection handoffs lacked actual generic question-specific planning, traceability, semantic review and version-bound plan confirmation.
capabilities.mechanism: Admit the strict externally pinned selected handoff; invoke one explicit no-tool planning callback, preserve exact inputs/failures and replay; validate many-to-many question/evidence/design/analysis/result links, retain unknowns and require separate bound semantic review and human plan decision. Offline workflow commands attach existing evidence to immutable externally pinned checkpoints, reconstruct status on resume and prepare unrun paired slots without dispatch. Offline evaluation prepare/record commands separately bind the generic guidance, frozen P7-P9 catalog, saved plan/intake and supplied raw judgment; preserve per-SQ evidence and scored/unverifiable/grader_error states without dispatch or readiness promotion. Optional actionable evaluation feedback binds one common profile across campaign subjects. P9 assessments retain a supported first step and deliverable, an evidence dependency and fallback, or both, with no change to scoring or plan authority.

capabilities.native_text_subject_contract: Opt-in offline prepare/inspect/record admits the existing Stage2 selection and original SQ context independently of any B plan, binds unchanged UTF8 bytes/raw hash and mechanically reversible line locators, and never extracts or fills scientific design. Inspect reconstructs source/current raw text; supplied judgments retain separate P7/P8/P9 states and canonical line evidence. Native identity, actual research/receiver acceptance, calibration, pairing and improvement remain unverified; authority flags false. Structured jobs/campaign masking explicitly refuse this raw type before dispatch or rewriting.
capabilities.evaluation_job_contract: Reuse the existing host job journal and P7/P8/P9 request/record validators for one explicitly configured R1/R2/ADJ adapter call; preserve raw judgments, prose/streams, actual exit or unknown, grader_error/unverifiable vectors and failed/partial captures. Canonical read-only replay reuses the completed Delivery A2 evaluator module bytes. Optional campaign recording/index attachment requires the pinned Delivery A implementation; missing dependency rejects before dispatch. No automatic judging, retries, authenticated identity, formal pairing or scientific improvement is established.
capabilities.planning_job_contract: Wrap the existing host Journal and strict selected workflow for one explicitly dispatched planning callback; bind project/index/workflow/current source/all SQ/schema/runtime/context and preserve saved or failed outcomes. Inspect and replay never dispatch. Partial/uncertain attempts remain execution-unknown until explicit saved-artifact reconciliation. NativePlanner owns actual deadlines and zero retries; no session/process manager, readiness gate or research authority is added. Synthetic job tests mock admission and do not establish live isolation or scientific validity. A separate completed-artifact inspect_saved path requires an original request hash and completion-manifest pin held outside the mutable Journal. It revalidates current semantic intake, source, schema and identity and authenticates the original recorded producer/runtime without treating it as current execution authority; it neither dispatches nor writes. Strict prepare, inspect, run and recover continue to require the current environment. Completed-artifact native inspection uses the original request fingerprint authenticated by the externally pinned plan manifest, rechecks prompt/schema/configuration/policy/attempt/output bytes and local semantics, and records the original evaluator identity without executing its code. This historical read cannot be used for correction; ordinary evaluator replay and all execution/resume paths stay current-environment strict.
capabilities.direction_intent_contract: Consume the externally pinned Stage2DirectionPlanningIntent and verified advisory package without generation or Host dispatch. Retain preferred current versions, original SQs, assessments, evidence, resources and unknowns. Keep selected_options empty, human_selection pending, formal_selected_receiver false and execution_authorized false. Reversible value sharing preserves exact source values and their hash within the existing prompt bound; missing SQ mapping or an oversized context cannot prepare a prompt. Formal selection, conditional job execution and scientific acceptance remain separate. A typed DirectionPlanningJobs subclass now reuses the existing journal, single explicit dispatch, failure capture, inspection and recovery; a separate conditional result must cover every original question_ref exactly once and cannot attach a formal selected plan or evaluation subject. Conditional jobs bound the complete serialized request before recording an intent, bind the complete CLI producer source tree on preparation and strict inspection or recovery, and recover an interrupted sealed result without another callback. Completed pure reads may use the same externally pinned original-artifact scope as selected plans; incomplete, changed-source or unpinned jobs retain strict rejection and no dispatch. Optional supplemental-evidence primitives bind named question needs, source receipt hashes and limitations to the original intent and source frontier. An explicit source-design-v1 research context pairs separate Host-configured callbacks and builds an independent review prompt over the full delivered plan, including its overview, original conditions and prior assessment advice. Review validation requires exact plan/intent hashes and original question closure. The helpers grant no execution authority and do not yet establish automatic job/native dispatch or quality improvement. With the explicit source-design-v1 evidence profile, durable direction jobs dispatch separate configured planning and independent whole-plan design-review callbacks. The native adapter binds the dedicated review operation, schema, prompt, raw output and original archive while retaining the same model, tools and finite deadline. Valid review records with unknown or needs-revision answers retain a saved needs-information package. Reviewer failures retain the completed plan and review bytes in the failed artifact inventory; exact same-key replay does not redispatch. Default jobs without this opt-in preserve their original prompt and single callback. This is planning engineering, not scientific or execution acceptance.
capabilities.legacy_mapping_contract: Explicit v1 packet/source-byte checked read-only question mapping retains manual origin, current versions, full original history, unknown resource status and missing review/human-choice blockers. It is not a strict delivery or a generation admission. Optional mapping enrichment still requires strict current delivery/interaction admission, exact logical packet equivalence, selected-version closure and trusted-host verification of the displayed mapping choice; no CLI override or fabricated old review. Bounded source capture precedes semantic validation; selected original approaches/limitations and packet unresolved context survive into hashed planning requests independently of decision conditions.
capabilities.condition_resolution_contract: Opt-in plan1.1 preserves default1.0 schema bytes; source-bound condition dispositions and evidence/deadline/owner/trigger/fallback unknown records add deterministic diagnostics without changing strict admission, human verification or conservative resource blocking. Assumption/deferred metadata never resolves evidence or authorizes execution.
capabilities.verified_input_origin_contract: Only after shared strict admission, deepcopy optional input_origin into the planning intake. Keep native/legacy absent origin absent, preserve typed project version and not-established human identity, and retain execution false. Projection alone is not admission; external pin or rehashed origin/choice tampering rejects through the public receiver.
capabilities.registered_material_frontier_contract: The explicit prepare_registered_materials and inspect_registered_materials API verifies same-project registered metadata, full original bytes/hash and caller-selected JSON pointers under the existing 2MB artifact and 48000-byte context bounds. Consumer project, typed input version, intent and delivery frontier remain distinct from the catalog, which records no input version. Matching partial reads reuse verified files; completed replay invokes no reader. Inspection reconstructs values from externally pinned originals and preserves unreviewed status, limits and false rights/scientific/execution flags. Trusted callers own authenticated catalog/read access and honest snapshot observation pins. This standalone preparation API does not dispatch a planner, reviewer, HTTP request or model; adapter and Host forwarding are a separate integration.
capabilities.typed_study_projection_contract: A separate closed raw schema and explicit project_study_route API validate four proposed study phases and matched-response or not-applicable verification steps. The projection derives only the existing public method field, retains original question keys, limits, unknowns and false execution authority, and does not mutate the raw value. This standalone schema/projection layer does not enable a planning job/profile, dispatch a model, seal a plan or change existing prompts; those are separate integration steps. Authored shape and compatibility tests establish no research quality.

capability_extensions.project_stage3_planning_contract: Programmatic trusted ProjectHost wiring reuses the same selected-project intake, existing PlanningJobs Journal and configured adapter. Prepare/read/inspect/recover never dispatch; an explicit confirmed HTTP run acknowledges admission separately and continues once in its existing request thread under the original native deadline. Current typed versions, selection receipt, external package hashes, all questions, conditions and unknowns are reverified. Browser fields cannot set paths, configuration, credentials or recovery pins. The original no-retry job semantics and five false authority flags remain unchanged; no worker, scheduler or chat wake adapter is created. JSON envelopes must be objects. Real research-package acceptance and native/scientific validation remain separate from the optional CLI composition.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_direction_planning_contra: A saved current direction preference enters the existing planning API with mode=direction-intent and the original intent hash/key. The Host rechecks principal, project frontier, immutable source pins and adapter context before dispatch and publication. Passive reads, save-only, prepare, inspect and recover make no planner call. Missing question mappings or oversized prompts retain the saved preference and return needs-information with visible blockers and no default_request. A complete identical pre-journal input may be reused; a mismatched or partial input is preserved and refused. The conditional view retains original questions, material mappings and the separate saved result for the Wiki presentation slice. Saved-job reuse rechecks the current model/adapter/source binding, and recovery availability uses the existing trusted pin map. Existing capture isolation, HTTP request thread and deadlines are reused. Each immutable project, reference and direction-intent hash gets a distinct capture inside the prevalidated direction namespace; same-intent replay retains its original capture and does not dispatch again. planning_target is stage3-planning-job; agent_conversation_connected and all authority flags stay false. Authored callback/DOM evidence does not establish deployed, native or scientific acceptance.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_planning_configuration_co: Closed externally hashed server-owned settings are validated before opening any Journal or listener. The factory composes the existing selected-project service, one original Journal with separate project owners, existing PlanningJobs and lazy NativePlanner. Real authenticated intake reference/internal-id/root form a Host journal identity token, never a native ProjectIndex or approval. Output paths and capture slots cannot overlap, trusted recovery pins stay server-only, and constructor cleanup preserves the primary failure and cleanup errors. Loading and factory construction dispatch zero calls. CLI activation, deployed lifecycle, real material availability, human selection and scientific improvement require separate acceptance; five authority flags remain false.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_cli_activation_contract: Opt-in closed externally hashed CLI settings compose the existing selected-project service, one original Journal and PlanningJobs owners, and original NativePlanner. Loading settings and starting the listener never dispatch. Real intake reference/internal-id/root form an explicit Host journal identity token, never a native ProjectIndex or approval. Native capture slots are explicit and no new key retries an attempted capture; trusted recovery pins remain server-only. Configured CLI request threads use the existing non-daemon ThreadingMixIn join. Only the CLI closes its factory Journal and intake after every original handler has drained, including non-run requests; an unconfirmed join leaves both open and reports the failure. The original native deadline and HTTP cap remain unchanged. Constructor/cleanup failures remain visible, and five authority flags remain false. Deterministic fixture tests do not establish real material availability, human selection or scientific improvement.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_existing_store_startup_co: Explicit existing-stage23-store mode retains source/hash/private/no-link checks, requires an existing intake database with bounded SQLite sidecar paths, forbids native Stage1/model/query/source registration and reuses only already matching direct imports. Default native Windows path reservations remain unchanged. This is startup compatibility, not a general proof of future output path lengths or research acceptance.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_wiki_contract: Reuse the existing planning page for source-bound per-SQ resources, designs, analyses, result interpretations, shared designs, unknown evidence/deadlines/fallbacks and milestones. Conditional direction mode keeps original source questions and resource mappings separate from generated advice and user/source unknowns. Plain labels distinguish a preferred version and conditional draft from formal selection; common resource values are shown as labeled fields and nested recorded details remain expandable. Recorded next-check text is readable, with original source markers and other fields available in expandable details. All original values and raw receipts are retained. English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese use inert textContent and no inferred scientific design. The entry prioritizes original context, recorded progress and an applicable next action; running/saved jobs hide start controls, saved needs-information remains explicit, and version/authority receipts are expandable. An accepted explicit run reads the actual job without another dispatch. Verified current job outcomes outrank retained connection errors, and an error affects controls only when its key/request hash matches; all historical errors remain in raw receipts. Loading, failures and unknown outcomes offer read/inspect guidance; responsive layout and keyboard focus are presentation checks only. When an explicit action hides its control, same-project focus moves to confirmation, draft review or saved-state reading. The canonical HTML URL carries encoded project and allowlisted language in its client-only fragment, without storage or a Host route change. Unknown or malformed projects select none; explicit locale/project changes replace the permalink, and review buttons scroll/focus without destroying it. Passive render, language changes and stale-project protection dispatch nothing; explicit actions keep the existing typed request/key and authority boundaries. A read-only Wiki diagram draws only explicit saved question, design, analysis, result and conditional references; missing links and source unknowns remain visible. The Wiki mounts the same version-bound selection component with scoped DOM; pending or uncertain submissions retain their original key, and preference remains distinct from formal selection. This presentation does not establish semantic sufficiency, human confirmation, actual receiver acceptance, calibration or A/B improvement.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_oneclick_contract: An explicit save-and-start selection click reuses the original selection key and existing APIs. Saved transaction status and fresh same-selection acknowledgements precede server-derived prepare, matching prepared request and one confirmed run. Save-only and passive reads never plan; stale projects/versions, existing jobs, unknown/failed receipts and response loss never automatically retry. HTTP202 is admission, not completion. Existing source/eligibility/authority guards and five false flags remain unchanged; deterministic DOM responses are synthetic, not real selected receiver or scientific evidence.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_read_verification_contrac: Only one locked synchronous planning GET may reuse a successful strict selection verification for the same intake, authenticated principal, project, bindings and verifier implementations. The intake lock and verification scope cover the complete HTTP view, including saved-plan inspection and optional feedback. Every new request, mutation and dispatch retains fresh source/frontier/version admission; failed reads, changed bindings, copied contexts in other threads and closed scopes cannot reuse. Saved direction refresh inspects the authenticated original job once and never dispatches. This reduces redundant verification only; HTTP and native deadlines, source guards and authority flags are unchanged. For a completed saved plan, the existing server-only recovery pin map may explicitly bind its original project/key/request hash and completion manifest. Selected and conditional GET readers then verify the original artifact environment separately from current semantic source, project, checkpoint, schema, configuration and adapter checks. The browser cannot supply this pin or invoke inspect_saved as a write action; absent, mismatched, incomplete or tampered artifacts fail closed. Execution and recovery keep their current-environment checks. Both selected and conditional projections retain the externally pinned completed-read scope through native-archive verification and plan reloading; they do not re-enter a current-evaluator replay after successful historical inspection.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_wiki_navigation_contract: After a validated accepted selection or an explicit continuation, allowlisted same-project Wiki navigation reloads the existing authenticated bootstrap so the committed revision and Stage3 route are read together. The original pending marker, selection/planning key and authority flags remain; reload does not resubmit or dispatch. Wrong project, language, stale version and suspended stage cannot navigate. This fixes a hash-only transition, not human selection or scientific acceptance.
capability_extensions.wiki_readability_contract: Saved conditional planning projects the existing question and seven scalar fields into eight ordered, initially collapsed source steps. This is navigation through a proposed plan, not inferred scientific links or completed execution. Explicit resource uses match the original candidate version and question; unknown availability and proposed fit stay unchanged, while unmapped material leads remain in the complete source text. Formal linked-record plans retain the existing graph. The saved preference receipt is separate from a fresh editing draft; passive rendering does not preselect or submit. Sidebar stages 1-6 preserve the canonical project/language permalink. The initial hashless entry is canonicalized to the currently loaded stage before the first push, and explicit stage changes add one browser history entry; Back, Forward and fragment navigation restore only the already loaded project and allowlisted locale, preserve local drafts and stage context, and neither write another history entry nor dispatch a request. Invalid or cross-project fragments cannot restore another project over the current overview. Later-stage preview labels do not grant execution.
capability_extensions.wiki_quantitative_presentation_contract: An optional closed Stage3QuantitativePresentation sidecar reuses the authenticated project-scoped material catalog and byte/hash-checked file GETs. It supports the same saved conditional plan and selected manual draft bindings as the authored research guide, including project, typed input, intent, plan manifest, question and exact draft receipt/number. It adds no planner, write endpoint, MIME override or CSP permission. Its independent 128KiB display bound, at most four JSON sources totaling1MiB and2048 scalar cells leave prior guide and upload capacities unchanged. Tables resolve explicit own-property JSON pointers into complete hash-bound sources without value coercion, invented missing values, aggregation or annualization. Charts and complete precision tables keep units, unknowns, limitations and original-plan next-step quotes; authored metadata and group estimates do not establish scientific validity, household distributions or successful experiments. Missing or invalid optional material leaves the original guide and plan readable. Current-view/epoch/revision/abort checks reject stale painting and prevent further source reads after invalidation. All five authority flags and original R11/other stored records remain unchanged.
capability_extensions.wiki_research_presentation_contract: An optional authored display guide is read through the existing authenticated manual-material GET API. Exact project, typed input version, direction-intent and saved plan-manifest bind its fixed filename and closed bounded JSON contract; every graph node, edge, material lead and baseline cites a verbatim string under the same question. Metadata byte count and SHA256, source quotes, graph references and duplicate ambiguity are verified before rendering. Old or malformed guides fail closed to the untouched original plan; abort and current-view guards prevent late cross-project painting. The generic renderer does not infer scientific relationships, promote prose material leads to mapped or available data, or change plan, choice, journal, permission or execution state. A separate closed version2 display variant binds the selected manual draft receipt and revision number as well as the original project/input/intent/manifest; its distinct material name and source quotes resolve only against that exact draft plan. Version changes, same-binding refreshes and late responses cannot repaint another revision. Original version1 files remain unchanged and stay with the original plan. Complete manual text and open checks remain expandable. Research visuals are authored interpretations requiring semantic review, not scientific proof. Original complete planning and unknowns remain available. Reading makes no model call or POST. When no same-version authored guide is registered, a deterministic reading projection uses only the selected question and exact current saved-plan or manual-revision text. It retains the existing version/receipt checks, preserves complete fields and unknowns, and groups bounded verbatim excerpts without inventing causal or feedback edges. Its separate labels describe source order rather than a scientifically validated loop. Invalid published guides and read failures remain explicit rather than being concealed by fallback. The original complete plan remains readable, and the projection performs no write, planner call or research execution. The current plan or explicitly selected manual draft leads with its research question, recorded comparison, flow and open conditions, followed by mapped resource availability and expected outputs. Technical evidence and the original version remain available in initially closed disclosures. An empty authored loop displays no feedback. Moving the design sheet before manual review does not change the selected receipt, revision history, resource status or available actions.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_feedback_contract: Explicit authenticated user comments append to the existing owned Journal, not native messages or generated research. The current project, typed input/revision, brief, original plan manifest/content and request hashes bind every record. Original packages, unknowns and Markdown remain unchanged. Explicit manual revisions bind existing comment receipts and an optional exact parent draft receipt. Only seven scalar question-planning fields may be edited. Complete revision fields share the existing 262144-byte whole-request budget, checked for HTTP and direct callers; comments retain their 1800-byte field and 4096-byte request limits. Authority, original Markdown, questions and unknowns cannot be replaced. Draft copies retain the original plan and are honestly labeled manual user drafts, not generated or accepted research. Same-key replay and GET receipt reconciliation do not redispatch or overwrite. Local writes participate in the existing HTTP admission/drain and body/deadline limits; all five authority flags stay false. Before publication, aggregate GET and individual write projections use the Host ASCII-escaped wire encoding and existing response cap. A near-cap original remains readable without the optional feedback envelope; an oversized comment or manual-draft projection is rejected before its journal write. Deterministic transport tests are engineering evidence, not deployed user, scientific or model-regeneration acceptance.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_feedback_ui_contract: Fresh current saved-plan bindings expose native comment and manual-draft forms through the existing authenticated API. The current project, typed version, source and parent plan hashes remain required. Uncertain outcomes retain the exact key and body; explicit receipt inspection or same-key retry never silently creates another operation. Only an exact prewrite refusal offers explicit editing, while retaining the refused text. Original planning, Markdown, questions and unknowns remain unchanged; manual drafts and source receipts are labeled separately. Three locales, initially folded details, retained editor disclosure and a scoped keyboard-focus action make the forms reachable without another request. No passive write, model call, new executor, storage or research authority is introduced. Synthetic VM checks establish composition and controls only; deployed desktop/mobile, human submission and Stage3 intake acceptance require separate evidence. The Wiki form and server accept complete revision fields within the existing 262144-byte whole-request budget instead of an independent short-field limit. Comments retain 1800-byte fields and 4096-byte requests; other planning actions keep their existing request limits. The original-copy and ASCII-escaped aggregate response caps still apply, and an exact prewrite size refusal retains the text for explicit editing.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_material_file_contract: Complete material files use the existing authenticated128MiB chunked upload and binary readback. File reads and upload lifecycle writes authorize the stored project; catalog rows are filtered by project access. A manual revision may bind a verified same-project Stage3 file by exact question, id, byte count and SHA256; the immutable revision receipt carries its input/plan/parent/comment bindings. Files remain outside scalar plan text, aggregate JSON responses, DOM text and automatic model context. Replays retain original identities; interrupted publication recovers verified bytes without overwrite. Explicit abort removes only incomplete owned chunks and atomically retains an abort event; explicit same-file restart preserves that history and increments the upload attempt, rejecting stale cancellation. Exact material prewrite refusals permit explicit editing without clearing uncertain-outcome guards. Registered files and their permissions remain unreviewed; all five authority flags remain false. Twenty-five MiB is a minimum tested capacity, not a new reduction of the existing128MiB limit.
capability_extensions.project_material_access_contract: Existing material file reads, upload chunks/finalization and catalog rows validate the stored project through the current authenticated ProjectIntakeService.read boundary. A caller-supplied project cannot replace that identity. Catalog filtering isolates unavailable project files per entry while retaining access to authorized readable projects; authorization and unexpected failures remain explicit. Configured saved-view semantics, original materials and authority remain unchanged. This independently reviewable security stage adds no revision reference, upload abort/restart, UI action, model call, stage completion or research permission. Controlled loopback faults and two authenticated fixture principals establish engineering behavior only, not deployed Host or scientific acceptance.
